description: Implementation of the Order Data Access Object (DAO) providing database operations for Order entities, including retrieval by ID and listing orders by store with filtering and sorting.

classes.name: OrderDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for managing Order entities, including methods for fetching orders by ID and listing orders with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an Order entity by its ID, with associated entities fetched via joins.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists orders for a given merchant store based on specified criteria, with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a single order by ID, including related entities such as order products, total, history, etc.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of orders for the specified store, applying filters like customer name, payment method, customer ID, with sorting and pagination.
